question: Among Formula 1 drivers who raced during the 1950s, which drivers completed a season in that decade with the same constructor in both the first and the last race they participated in, while also taking part in at least two distinct race rounds during that season?
sql:
WITH driver_year AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT year, driver_id
  FROM drives
  WHERE year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
),
first_last AS (
  SELECT 
    dy.year,
    dy.driver_id,
    (SELECT d2.constructor_id FROM drives d2 
     WHERE d2.year = dy.year AND d2.driver_id = dy.driver_id 
     ORDER BY d2.first_round ASC LIMIT 1) as first_race_constructor,
    (SELECT d2.constructor_id FROM drives d2 
     WHERE d2.year = dy.year AND d2.driver_id = dy.driver_id 
     ORDER BY d2.last_round DESC LIMIT 1) as last_race_constructor,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d2.first_round) FROM drives d2 
     WHERE d2.year = dy.year AND d2.driver_id = dy.driver_id) as distinct_rounds
  FROM driver_year dy
)
SELECT 
  fl.year,
  dr.forename,
  dr.surname,
  c.name as constructor_name
FROM first_last fl
JOIN drivers dr ON dr.driver_id = fl.driver_id
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructor_id = fl.first_race_constructor
WHERE fl.first_race_constructor = fl.last_race_constructor
  AND fl.distinct_rounds >= 2
ORDER BY fl.year, dr.surname, dr.forename
